title: Access-gated shape does not silently degrade to open ingress when the AUD block drifts absent (aud-presence-check refuses)
asA: shelf consumer who applied edge-cloudflare-tunnel v1.0.0 with zeroTrustGate on
iWant: a probe that asserts the ingress rule keeps its originRequest.access.aud block on every reapply and refuses if the block drifts absent
soThat: a silent config drift to open ingress is caught at gate rather than at first probing

acceptanceCriteria.description: aud-presence-check FAILS under SIMULATE_AUD_DROP when the gated fixture ingress drifts to omit the originRequest.access block. The finding names the affected rule and the missing AUD value.

coverageNote: The single documented drift path (an access-gated fixture that omits the originRequest.access block, exercised via SIMULATE_AUD_DROP) is bound by this AC; the deeper edge-side reject/accept branches live on US-39106 as the four accessGatedReject*/AcceptValid ACs, so a single AC on this story is sufficient per section 7a.
